claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars will air live on ABC on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
Streaming options for the 2026 Oscars include Hulu + Live TV, Fubo, YouTube TV, and Directv.
Hulu is the official streaming home.
Hulu + Live TV plans start at $89.99/month.
Hulu + Live TV includes a 3-day free trial.
Fubo plans start at $45.99 for the first month.
Sling TV offers access to ABC.
YouTube TV is available for streaming the live broadcast.
ABC App/Website allows streaming if you sign in with a participating cable/satellite provider.
The ABC broadcast can be accessed over-the-air using a TV antenna for free.
